Passages:
[1] [Equity Compensation > About Your Ownership in GitLab > Exercising Your Options]
You may exercise and hold your options (cash exercise) even outside of an open trading window. If you are a Designated Insider, please submit an Equity Compass ticket from your GitLab dashboard for assistance on exercising and managing your E-TRADE account. Team members will have 5 trading days to execute their exercise. Please seek advice from your financial advisor or tax advisor prior to processing your exercise.

[2] [Equity Compensation > About Your Ownership in GitLab > RSU Vesting & Grant Cadence]
RSUs are grants of shares of the Company's common stock, the vesting of which is based on the requisite service requirement.

Per our [SAFE framework](/handbook/legal/safe-framework/), we do not add specific dates to the handbook regarding equity. For more information on grant cadence & vesting, please see the following [slide deck](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/176GjzzcrEpdMz9X5NPD5c_YojhD33KPO5f1jGiG9j8c/edit?slide=id.p#slide=id.p).

- RSUs begin vesting on the corresponding grant date.
- RSUs are reviewed for approval quarterly.
- Promotion and Refresh Grants do not require a cliff, begin vesting quarterly for three-year vest.
- Shares are not expected to post to E*TRADE on the vest date itself. The release process starts after market close, when the closing stock price is available, and the taxable value of the shares can be determined. From there, please allow up to 5 stock market trading days for shares to be reflected in E*TRADE.

[3] [GitLab Offboarding FAQ > Timing > Total Rewards - Benefits > What if I am a designated Insider?]
If you decide to trade in GitLab's stock or other securities prior to the 90th day following the end of your employment or service relationship with GitLab, we suggest that you evaluate whether you have MNPI prior to trading.

Question: How many stock market trading days should a GitLab team member allow for shares to be reflected in E*TRADE after the release process starts?

Answer:
Team members should allow up to 5 stock market trading days for shares to be reflected in E*TRADE after the release process starts [2].
